description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequestFromClerk" name="Credit scoring requested by clerk"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringReply" name="Scoring reply"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ClerkDelayMessage" name="Delay message for clerk"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FinalResult" name="Final scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Frontend" name="Sales Clerk Frontend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Banking" name="Banking System" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ClerkRequest" name="Credit scoring request" sourceRef="Participant_Frontend" targetRef="StartEvent_ClerkRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequestToAgency" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_AgencyRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResultToBanking" name="Immediate result" sourceRef="SendTask_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveReply"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNoticeToBanking" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="SendTask_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveReply"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FinalResultToBanking" name="Final result" sourceRef="SendTask_SendFinalResult" targetRef="Event_FinalResultReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResultToClerk" name="Result" sourceRef="SendTask_PresentImmediateResult" targetRef="Participant_Frontend"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayMessageToClerk" name="Check again later" sourceRef="SendTask_DisplayDelayMessage" targetRef="Participant_Frontend"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FinalResultToClerk" name="Final result" sourceRef="SendTask_PresentFinalResult" targetRef="Participant_Frontend"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking System Credit Scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClerkRequest" name="Credit scoring requested by clerk">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ClerkRequest" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequestFromClerk"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveReply" name="Receive scoring reply from agency" messageRef="Msg_ScoringReply"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReplyContent" name="Reply content?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_PresentImmediateResult" name="Present result to clerk" messageRef="Msg_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImmediateShown" name="Result shown"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_DisplayDelayMessage" name="Display message to clerk to check again later" messageRef="Msg_ClerkDelayMessage"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FinalResultReceived" name="Final result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FinalResultReceived" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_PresentFinalResult" name="Present final result to clerk" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FinalShown" name="Result shown"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClerkRequest" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequest" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveReply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B3" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveReply" targetRef="Gateway_ReplyContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B4" name="Decision information present" sourceRef="Gateway_ReplyContent" targetRef="SendTask_PresentImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B5" sourceRef="SendTask_PresentImmediateResult" targetRef="EndEvent_ImmediateShown"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B6" name="Delay announced" sourceRef="Gateway_ReplyContent" targetRef="SendTask_DisplayDelayMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B7" sourceRef="SendTask_DisplayDelayMessage" targetRef="Event_FinalResultReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B8" sourceRef="Event_FinalResultReceived" targetRef="SendTask_PresentFinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B9" sourceRef="SendTask_PresentFinalResult" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalShown"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Level1Result" name="Result determined immediately?" default="Flow_A4"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate result to banking system" messageRef="Msg_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImmediateSent" name="Immediate result sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendDelayNotice" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendFinalResult" name="Send scoring result to banking system" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FinalSent" name="Final result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="StartEvent_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_Level1Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Result" targetRef="SendTask_SendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Result" targetRef="SendTask_SendDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="SendTask_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="EndEvent_ImmediateSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="SendTask_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="SendTask_SendFinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="SendTask_SendFinalResult" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
